summary.en: Cross-platform mobile app with Stack, Tab and Drawer navigation, FlatList views, dynamic cart calculations and Jest unit tests.
summary.id: Aplikasi mobile lintas platform dengan navigasi Stack, Tab dan Drawer, tampilan FlatList, perhitungan keranjang dinamis dan unit test Jest.

summary.en: Analyzed a business scenario end to end (Ask, Prepare, Process, Analyze, Share, Act) and presented data-driven recommendations.
summary.id: Menganalisis skenario bisnis dari awal sampai akhir (Ask, Prepare, Process, Analyze, Share, Act) dan menyajikan rekomendasi berbasis data.

summary.en: Journaling app with Swift 6, SwiftUI, MVVM and SwiftData, featuring on-device AI summaries, MapKit, live weather data and Swift Charts.
summary.id: Aplikasi jurnal dengan Swift 6, SwiftUI, MVVM dan SwiftData, dilengkapi ringkasan AI on-device, MapKit, data cuaca langsung dan Swift Charts.

summary.en: Event discovery app with MapKit pins and category filters, Swift Charts, SwiftData offline storage and a concept AI event-tips widget.
summary.id: Aplikasi pencarian acara dengan pin MapKit dan filter kategori, Swift Charts, penyimpanan offline SwiftData dan konsep widget tips acara berbasis AI.

summary.en: Integrated a Blazor front end with an ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core and ASP.NET Identity in a full-stack .NET application, using Microsoft Copilot.
summary.id: Mengintegrasikan front end Blazor dengan Web API ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core dan ASP.NET Identity dalam aplikasi .NET full-stack, dengan bantuan Microsoft Copilot.

summary.en: Analyzed employee data in Python (EDA, visualization, predictive modeling) to identify drivers of attrition, including overwork, and recommended retention actions.
summary.id: Menganalisis data karyawan dengan Python (EDA, visualisasi, pemodelan prediktif) untuk menemukan penyebab karyawan keluar, termasuk beban kerja berlebih, dan merekomendasikan langkah retensi.

summary.en: Java desktop application with integrated data handling and a graphical interface, applying object-oriented design and unit testing.
summary.id: Aplikasi desktop Java dengan pengolahan data terintegrasi dan antarmuka grafis, menerapkan desain berorientasi objek dan unit testing.

summary.en: Combined React, Node.js, Express and Django into a full-stack web application deployed to the cloud with containers and CI/CD.
summary.id: Menggabungkan React, Node.js, Express dan Django menjadi aplikasi web full-stack yang di-deploy ke cloud dengan container dan CI/CD.

summary.en: Planned a BI project, built a data pipeline and designed an interactive Tableau dashboard with an executive summary.
summary.id: Merencanakan proyek BI, membangun pipeline data dan merancang dasbor Tableau interaktif dengan ringkasan eksekutif.
